4276-5088-5252.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U}.
4276-5088-5252.description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Shigeki's channel ability by paying {4}{G}{G} and discarding it, returning Turnabout and Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Shigeki to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2034-2178-2380.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2034-2178-2380.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Repeat.

3532-5060-5078-7864.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

104-1379-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1379-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3249-5173-5542.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4359-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

3490-4050-6823-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6823-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4779-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2342-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
2342-6556-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

539-5256-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1580-4871-5256-6663.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

4691-5541-5919.notablePrerequisites: Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
4691-5541-5919.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Vilis to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

2178-3113-3500.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3113-3500.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

261-859-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Splinter Twin attached to Lurking Roper.
261-859-4702.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
When the Lurking Roper token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Lurking Roper you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.

856-1960-2882-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Brandywine Farmer.
You control a Food.
856-1960-2882-4050.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of Brandywine Farmer due to Infinite Reflection.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Repeat for infinite Food tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brandywine Farmer, adding one mana of any color.
When Brandywine Farmer dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 8.

1869-3089-3821-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Conspiracy.
1869-3089-3821-4875.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1751-2373.description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {9}{R}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast nine times.
Cast Phyresis Outbreak by paying {2}{B}.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Phyresis Outbreak nine times.
Resolve each Phyresis Outbreak, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

23-776-1329-3682.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-3682.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Mox Amber to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Mox Amber.
Cast Mox Amber.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
